name: High Flex Active USB3 cable (ULHLU11AC12)

sources.title: High Flex Active USB3 Extension Cable (Newnex product page)
sources.covers: part numbers, connectors, lengths, outer diameter, dynamic bend radius, flex life and its test radius, jacket

note: An active high-flex USB 3 cable, A to C with USB3 Vision screw locks (ULHLU11AC12-5M 5 m, ULHLU11AC12-8M 8 m; the A-to-A-female extensions ULHL-EX-6M and ULHL-EX-8M are the same cable). Stated: outer diameter 6.3 mm; minimum dynamic bend radius "12 x OD (approx. 75 mm)" (min_bend_dynamic_mm 75 is the page's rounded figure; 12 x 6.3 mm is 75.6 mm); flex life ">= 6,000,000 cycles", tested at a 75 mm bending radius; drag-chain, continuous motion and tick-tock rated; orange TPE jacket. Not stated: the static (fixed) bend radius, the mass, the power the active electronics draw. The page links no datasheet PDF.
